content: The average distance from the Earth to the Sun is about 93 million miles, or approximately 150 million kilometers. This distance is also referred to as an astronomical unit (AU), which is a standard measure used in astronomy to describe distances within our solar system. The actual distance can vary slightly throughout the year due to the elliptical shape of Earth's orbit.
